body:
Integration seat, relaunched after rotation (same handle, claude-implementer-1056).

1. PR #4056 (BUG-2555 re-apply) is at a new head 88cbc7077ad and needs the delta review. It answers the CHANGES REQUESTED at a272b820a12: scripts/check-store-writers.py now knows the write_atomic_mode sink, and the six allocator rows are regenerated in the store-writer inventory (checker reconciles 3624 sites). The fast gate is running in that worktree now; I will report its result.

2. origin/integration is still 7d0c929ce9d. The candidate 31ab86c57e2 (#4047 + main ce660d5 + #3950) is NOT pushed: seat_clone_handshake_tests::the_hook_reports_queued_then_unreachable_then_the_ack fails on it and passed at 7d0c929. dell1 is off (no route to host), so the bisect waits; I am reading the code meanwhile.

3. S3a (STORY-2768 housekeeping, head 111afc8953e) is being opened as a PR against integration now.
subject: Integration seat: #4056 new head 88cbc7077ad for delta review; candidate held
